changelog:
- Updated the model references: the default model is now airtap-1.0-flash instead of airtap-1.0-lite.
- Model selection guidance revised: use airtap-1.0-flash for lower latency on shorter tasks; use airtap-1.0 for more complex or reliable tasks.
- Model list command description updated to mention new model options and possible debug-only models.
- Example commands and related text now refer to airtap-1.0-flash as the default.
- No code or infrastructure changes; documentation only.
